facts.business: Aviva Industries Limited is engaged in the sale of goods, recognizing revenue upon transfer of control to customers, mainly upon delivery.

auditor.name: S K Bhavsar & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: 1) Management did not furnish balance confirmation letters, party-wise reconciliation statements, and age-wise analysis for certain Trade Receivable and Trade Payable balances as at 31st March 2026, so auditors unable to satisfy themselves on existence, completeness, accuracy, and recoverability; impact not ascertainable. 2) Satisfactory supporting documents not provided for completeness of valuation of inventory as on 31st March 2026. 3) Company has not appointed an Internal Auditor for the entire Financial Year 2025-26, constituting non-compliance with Section 138 of Companies Act, 2013. 4) Significant trade payables; bifurcation between Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and others not provided (text truncated).

key_risks: Lack of balance confirmations and reconciliations for trade receivables and payables
Insufficient supporting documentation for inventory valuation
Non-appointment of Internal Auditor for full FY 2025-26, resulting in significant gap in internal control framework
Trade payables bifurcation between MSME and others not provided
